the Internet is a powerful medium for consumers to learn about their health and that consumers use the Internet for both medical care and support.

the Internet has the potential to be an effective tool for improving healthcare, but more research is needed to determine how this tool can be best utilized to improve the health of Americans.

Internet users with a medical condition are more likely to seek medical care and those who have a friend or loved one with a medical condition will be more likely to seek information and support online.

consumers who use the Internet for health information are more likely to seek help for their health concerns, and that these help-seeking behaviors are more pronounced for those who are more educated, have a higher income, and who are more concerned about their health status.

Internet health information consumers are more likely to be women, to have lower income, and to be younger, and that these individuals are using the Internet to seek medical information for their own health problems as well as for those of a loved one.

the Internet can be a powerful tool in improving health outcomes, especially if it can be used to help consumers make better decisions about their healthcare.
